title: Integral one-uniformizer intrinsic Koszul unit
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $R$ and uniformizer $t$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a scheme $T$ with its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Put $B=\varprojlim_n(R/t^{n+1})_T$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], with $t$ acting through its actual compatible residues. Use the unbounded module derived category and cochain representatives of [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. For $K\in D(B)$, a complex $P$, and an isomorphism $e:Q(P)\simeq K$, form the single-generator Koszul tower $M_n=P\otimes_B[B\xrightarrow{t^{n+1}}B]$ in degrees $[-1,0]$, with consecutive transition $(t,1)$, as in intrinsic completion [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion]. Put $D_P=\prod_n M_n$ and $f=1-s$ [def-weil-tower-transition-endomorphism]. The intrinsic fiber has terms $D_P^i\oplus D_P^{i-1}$ and differential $(x,y)\mapsto(dx,fx-dy)$. If $u:P\to D_P$ has components the degree-zero Koszul inclusions, define the intrinsic unit on $K$ to be $e^{-1}$ followed by $Q((u,0)):Q(P)\to Q(\operatorname{Fib}(f))$. This records the actual representative-normalized map, not the theorem identifying it with quotient completion.
